Definition: from G1909 and G4637; to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with:--rest upon.
BiblicalUsage: Episkenoo means to rest upon, to tent upon — and Christ says to Paul, My grace is sufficient for thee, for my strength is made perfect in weakness, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
TheologicalSignificance: Not removal, but presence: the resting is the answer to the thorn, and Christ's power pitches its tent over my weakness.
